description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your subroutine diverts a portion of your spell's energy to create a shield. If your next action is to Cast a Spell, you or your minion with the tech trait gains temporary Hit Points equal to double the rank of the spell that last 1 minute. If the spell deals at least one type of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void), you or your minion gain resistance to an energy damage type of your choice equal to the spell's rank for as long as the temporary Hit Points remain.
